reason: I'd take the free call and the 15 companies, since that costs me nothing, but I'm not paying EUR 1,600 off a pitch. The last agency also had a nice guarantee and a case study, and I got slides, so I'd rather put that money toward Apollo and a junior who sits in my office.
objection: One case study with 45 meetings and no name. Then 'qualified' turns into a fight about whether some guy at a fair was a real buyer, and getting a refund back from an agency on day 90 is never as easy as the brochure says.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free targets include companies I didn't already know and would actually want, and I can talk to that logistics client myself, I'd sign the pilot.
